proposal.summary: The CI workflow currently checks TypeScript syntax but does not connect to the existing asserted catalog behavior suite, leaving documented inventory invariants without automated CI feedback. A bounded CI wiring change would include the existing package test suite, providing behavioral feedback without duplicating assertions. Validation scope covers CI test discovery and failure propagation; restoring the prior workflow configuration is the rollback.
proposal.title: CI catalog behavior-suite wiring

summary: Fresh evidence shows CI performs a syntax check while the package defines a test suite with assertions for duplicates, negative stock, and fractional stock. Connecting that existing suite in CI is a bounded verification improvement; no execution results are supplied.
unverifiedChecks: Whether CI discovers the existing catalog suite and reports assertion failures remains unverified.
